claim: Parameter sharing reduces the overall number of learning parameters and can enhance learning efficiency compared to training separate processes.
falsifier: One can compare the number of parameters and learning efficiency (e.g., convergence speed) between a multi-agent system with parameter sharing and one with separate training, under the same task and environment.

conditions: Compared to training in separate processes
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported survey context and the specific methods that employ parameter sharing; transfer beyond those settings is unestablished.

title: Parameter sharing combined for number of learning parameters
